title: A committed DOCX edit no longer re-serializes the paragraphs it did not touch, and the ordinary snapshot stops copying the main part
code_state: crates/litchi-docx only: document/transaction.rs, document/mod.rs, package/package/document.rs and package/tests/graph.rs; one new public enum and two new public Edit methods; no signature changed and no item removed; no new unsafe and no new dependency (xml-minifier was already a litchi-docx dependency); no facade change, because litchi::document does not expose the document transaction
authority: change 0652 decision 10 (DOCX half), queue row 10 of change 0651; part (c) of change 0591 and the last of its named limitations
reason_codes: the owner's decision 10 asks for a public compaction policy whose default leaves unmodified paragraphs and parts untouched, with whole-document compaction opt-in, and for the main-part copy in document_snapshot to be removed with it

the whole-document compaction and the rescan that followed it were 133.2 M of the 572.6 M instructions of one docx_semantic_one_edit_save lifecycle; compacting only the changed paragraphs and deriving the layout through 0591's splice route removes both

the OPC writer's authored-XML compactness contract refuses preserved bytes for 54 of the 55 openable DOCX fixtures, so the default consults that auditor first and falls back to the unchanged whole-document route; the contract is change 0652's decision 2, a separate record in this wave, and is not moved here

the fallback's cost is bounded by a short-circuit on the one refusal that holds unconditionally -- character data outside the root element -- which decides 53 of those 54 fixtures from about sixty bytes of prologue
the corpus census is the oracle: 63 fixtures x ten aspects on both legs, byte-identical on every aspect and every refusal string except the opt-in aspect the base leg cannot run

sharing the main part's Arc instead of copying it is safe on its face -- Part::set_blob and set_blob_shared replace the Arc rather than mutating through it -- and makes the pointer half of 0591's exact-source proof hit on the eager route

accepted_evidence.census: a scratch probe over every DOCX-family fixture under test-data (63 found, 55 open), ten aspects per fixture covering the ordinary save, the exact no-op, the managed insert-and-publish route, a one-paragraph rewrite under each policy, the source-versus-published byte span and a reopen, on both legs, 630 lines each
accepted_evidence.counts: callgrind isolation pairs at N=1 and N=3 differenced and halved on the three docx_semantic_* selectors, both legs, inclusive Ir and call counts per symbol
accepted_evidence.region: the same probe's commit-only region -- edit(), one replace_paragraph_text and commit() -- as an isolation pair at measured = 1 and 3, for a compact and a line-break-after-declaration source at 24, 200 and 10,000 paragraphs, both legs, 24 runs
accepted_evidence.timing: 100 samples per pooled leg, order A1 B1 B2 A2 on CPU 15, nine semantic scenarios plus four docx_ordinary_save_* control scenarios, in three separate windows, with the A/A and B/B floors of each window beside every paired delta
accepted_evidence.in_crate_tests: nine new tests, including a corpus differential over 53 snapshot-able fixtures and 99 accepted rewrites that checks both policies per rewrite, and a check that the cheap short-circuit never refuses what the auditor accepts, run against every corpus fixture

accepted_costs.default_behaviour_change: Edit::commit's default output bytes change for a source that satisfies the publication contract and is not invariant under compaction; CompactionPolicy::WholeDocument restores the previous bytes exactly, and no fixture in this repository is in that class
accepted_costs.refusal_narrowing: a refusal raised only because whole-document compaction re-serialized untouched markup -- an xml:space value other than default or preserve in a paragraph the edit never named is the case -- is not raised under the default policy; the opt-in still raises it with the identical error, and no snapshot-level refusal moved
accepted_costs.fallback_overhead: a source the publication gate refuses pays the short-circuit on top of everything the base leg did: 1,695 instructions on a 24-paragraph document (+0.59% of the commit region), +0.05% at 200 paragraphs and below measurement at 10,000
accepted_costs.gate_on_the_preserving_route: a source the short-circuit does not decide pays one whole-document verify_authored pass, 44.9 M Ir per lifecycle on the harness corpora; it is bought back several times over by the 133.2 M the change removes
accepted_costs.declined_shapes: a commit that changes the paragraph count, or a document whose root or w:body declares xml:space, publishes its projection without compacting any fragment; the authored fragments those operations splice are compact by construction
accepted_costs.aliasing: document_snapshot's returned Snapshot now aliases the main part's payload allocation; Part has no in-place payload mutator, and a retained package test pins both the aliasing and its survival across a publication
accepted_costs.instruction_counts: instructions rank work, not latency; callgrind overstates the removed bulk copy, and paired timing does not resolve it either, so the copy is claimed as removed work and not as a speed-up
accepted_costs.measurement_windows: three paired-timing windows were run and all three are retained; w1 timed the change binary before a no-op refactor that merged two identical match arms and moved three private functions, w2 and w3 timed the committed binary. w2 was heavily contended (B/B floor -27.05% on one scenario, -60.57% on an ordinary-save control) and nothing rests on it; the record quotes w3, whose floors are at most 1.69% at p50, and the large one-edit delta reads -31.82%, -33.76% and -34.14% across the three

known_gaps.reach_of_the_default: the preserving route is reachable on 1 of the 55 openable fixtures today because of the publication audit; change 0652's decision 2 lifts that, and publication_accepts_preserved_xml is the single function that then has to change
known_gaps.no_op_saving_near_the_floor: the removed main-part copy is not resolved by timing: the no-op scenarios read -1.07% to -2.12% at p50 in the quoted window against an A/A floor reaching 1.69%, and +0.22% to -0.97% in the contended one; the deterministic support is Snapshot::from_xml falling from 3 calls to 0 per lifecycle and no latency figure is claimed
known_gaps.allocation_profile: litchi-perf-baseline-alloc reports no metrics for the docx_semantic_* family, so the removed allocation is counted from the call site and not measured by the allocator
known_gaps.other_rewrite_sites: the eleven Edit rewrite sites change 0591 left rescanning still rescan; tables, block content controls and the body-final section properties are preserved rather than compacted
known_gaps.document_mut_route: MutableDocument::to_xml still compacts whole documents; the docx_ordinary_save_* selectors that use it are a control here, not a target
known_gaps.real_producer_scale: no real-producer document larger than 12 KB of main part was measured; the fixture corpus is small

withheld: any registered speedup, throughput, cold-cache, physical-I/O, peak-RSS, concurrency-scaling or cross-platform result
any claim that the default policy changes published bytes on this corpus: it does not, on any fixture, on any route
